description: This file defines the VoiceWakeManager class, which manages voice wake-word detection and speech recognition using Apple's AVFoundation and Speech frameworks, along with related buffer management and permissions handling.

classes.name: AudioBufferQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe buffer queue for managing AVAudioPCMBuffer objects used during speech recognition.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing voice wake-word detection, speech recognition, and related audio session configuration.

methods.name: makeAudioTapEnqueueCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback function to enqueue audio buffers into the buffer queue.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an AVAudioPCMBuffer, copying its channel data.

methods.name: configureAudioSession
methods.description: Sets up the AVAudioSession category and activates it for recording.

methods.name: requestMicrophonePermission
methods.description: Requests microphone permission asynchronously with a timeout.

methods.name: requestSpeechPermission
methods.description: Requests speech recognition permission asynchronously with a timeout.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Configures and starts the speech recognition engine and audio input tap.

methods.name: tearDownRecognitionPipeline
methods.description: Stops and cleans up the speech recognition pipeline and audio engine.

methods.name: handleRecognitionCallback
methods.description: Handles recognition results, extracting commands and triggering actions.

methods.name: extractCommand
methods.description: Extracts command words from recognition transcripts based on trigger words.
